_about: Weights for the Ranked view of the queue. Edit and reload the page: the score is recomputed in the browser. score = tier points (by request type) + 1 point per days_per_point days past the city's promised date (up to cap) + points_per_extra_report for each extra open report of the same type at the same address (up to cap). Ties go to the request furthest past its date. Move a request type between tiers with tier_overrides, e.g. {"Sirens Not Heard": 1}. Design: research/prioritisation-option.md. No model, no text, no demographics.

1.label: Life-safety, blocked right of way or loss of an essential service

2.label: A hazard or loss of function that is not immediate

3.label: Everything else: property maintenance, nuisance, amenity, administrative

review_first: Sirens Not Heard (tier 2; arguably 1 as a warning-system fault)
Lead Insp (tier 2; arguably 1 where children are present, which the file does not show)
Sign needs attention (tier 2; a missing stop sign is tier 1, but the code does not say)
Illegal Use (tier 2; blocking and obstruction are not distinguished)
